metadata.page_title: Pat Pidgeon vs Millan’s Last Supper matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 59.2. Pat Pidgeon left 11.4 lineup points on the table, while Millan’s Last Supper left 21.9.
summary.historical_summary: Pat Pidgeon is 6-4 against Millan’s Last Supper across 10 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 59.2, led by a 59.8-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Jahmyr Gibbs (43.6) and Zay Flowers (26.0).
summary.loser_reason: Millan’s Last Supper could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 59.8 points. George Kittle scored 1.2. A best legal lineup added 21.9, still short of the 59.2-point margin.
